name: io.github.kwizzlesurp10-ctrl/x402orcle
description: Paid x402 Oracle MCP on Base USDC: demand counsel, Bazaar rewrites, and HTTP 402 diagnostics.

tools.name: oracle_health
tools.description: Check x402 Oracle server health, configured Base payTo posture, facilitator mode (demo or live), and seller-key safety flags. Free and read-only; requires no arguments or payment header. Use this before calling paid consult tools to verify availability; use oracle_pricing to inspect USD fees.

tools.name: oracle_pricing
tools.description: List all free and paid x402 Oracle endpoints, current clamped USDC prices on Base, max price ceiling, and connection instructions. Free and read-only; takes no parameters. Call this instead of oracle_health when selecting a paid consult tool and budgeting payment amount.

tools.name: oracle_ask
tools.description: Ask a general architectural or ranking question about x402 micropayments, MCP monetization, A2A agent cards, or CDP Bazaar discovery ($0.10 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return an HTTP 402 challenge envelope (`isError: true`); retry with `_meta['x402/payment']`. Use oracle_diagnose_402 instead to inspect a raw PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

question.description: Specific technical question on x402 wire format, MCP payment wrapping, A2A discovery, or Bazaar ranking.

audience.description: Target framing for the returned verdict and implementation prompt ('agent', 'developer', or 'operator').

tools.name: oracle_diagnose_402
tools.description: Decode and audit an HTTP 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64 or JSON) for accepts[], Base USDC terms, extensions.bazaar schema validity, and resource.url alignment ($0.50 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use this instead of oracle_review_mcp when debugging a single 402 payload before facilitator settlement.

challenge_b64_or_json.description: Raw base64-encoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or its decoded JSON string.

resource_url.description: Optional canonical HTTPS URL of the protected endpoint being challenged.

tools.name: oracle_review_mcp
tools.description: Audit a paid MCP server architecture for x402 payment wrapping, declareDiscoveryExtension metadata, free health tooling, Streamable HTTP compliance, and seller-key isolation ($3.00 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use oracle_bazaar_rewrite for listing copy or oracle_diagnose_402 for single header checks.

mcp_url.description: Public MCP endpoint URL or deployment path under review (e.g. 'https://example.com/mcp').

notes.description: Optional transport, runtime, and paid tool summary (e.g. 'streamable-http, two paid tools').

tools.name: oracle_bazaar_rewrite
tools.description: Generate SEO-optimized CDP Bazaar metadata (serviceName <=32 chars, description <=500 chars, <=5 tags) front-loaded with buyer search phrases and first-index freeze warnings ($1.50 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use this before settling a new SKU; for broader launch diffs use complete_oracle_task.

current_description.description: Optional existing Bazaar resource description to rewrite for higher buyer-query match.

buyer_phrases.description: Optional list of target buyer search queries to front-load into serviceName and description.

tools.name: complete_oracle_task
tools.description: Execute a high-depth outcome planning task delivering typed diffs, security constraints, operator handoff checklists, and ship verification steps for an x402 production launch goal ($10.00 USDC on Base). Unpaid calls return 402 terms. Use for end-to-end delivery plans; use oracle_ask ($0.10) for shorter Q&A.

goal.description: Concrete production delivery objective (e.g. 'List oracle_ask on CDP Bazaar after first mainnet settle').

constraints.description: Optional security, budget, or hosting constraints (e.g. 'seller-only host, no EVM_PRIVATE_KEY').
